# Amazon FAR ABC source

The following files in this directory are copied from the Amazon FAR ABC
repository and are not original code in this project:

- `config.py`
- `dataloader.py`
- `dit.py`
- `operator.py`
- `preprocess.py`
- `__init__.py`

Source repository: https://github.com/amazon-far/abc

These files provide ABC's episode dataset, normalization, prompt utilities,
CLIP text embedder, TorchCodec video decoding, and worker-based data loading.
The original project license is preserved at `../ABC_LICENSE`.
